name: QBasic / QuickBASIC
summary: Microsoft's structured BASIC of the MS-DOS era: QuickBASIC compiler (1985) and the bundled QBasic interpreter (1991), with SUB/FUNCTION procedures, TYPE records, SELECT CASE and optional line numbers.

level_notes.0: Microsoft's implementation is closed; QB64 and FreeBASIC are open compatible implementations.
level_notes.1: No standard and no online vendor manual; the QB64 wiki is the best open keyword reference. qb64phoenix.com rate-limits (HTTP 409) automated clients.
level_notes.2: Tutorials are mostly on personal sites of uncertain stability; none linked.

resources.title: QB64 Phoenix Edition — modern QuickBASIC-compatible compiler (BASIC to C++)
